description: This Python source file implements an OpenAI DALL-E image generation service class, `OpenAIImageGenService`, which integrates with OpenAI's API to generate images from text prompts. It includes methods for initializing the service with API credentials and parameters, and a method `run_image_gen` that performs asynchronous image generation and retrieval.
